responses:
I wouldn't send the offer yet. Of the three lines in the analysis, one is correct, one gets the tender's requirement wrong and one cites a clause the tender doesn't have. The analysis also leaves out most of what the tender actually requires.

## Checking each line against the tender

| # | What the analysis says | What the tender says | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | "Tender 7.1 requires 5 years" warranty | **7.1: 24 months from the date of commissioning** | **Wrong requirement.** A 5-year offer is more than the tender asks, so it still complies. But the analysis states the requirement wrongly, and we're offering 3 extra years of warranty that may not be priced in. Check this is intended. |
| 2 | "Paint to RAL 5015 (4.6)" | Section 4 stops at 4.5. RAL and paint finish don't appear anywhere in the tender. | **Made up.** The clause and the requirement don't exist. Remove this line. |
| 3 | 400 V, 3-phase, 50 Hz (4.1) | 4.1 matches exactly | Correct. Our offer is described as "400 V 50 Hz" without "3-phase", so confirm that. |

## Requirements the analysis leaves out

| Clause | Requirement | What it means for this offer |
|---|---|---|
| **4.2 + 9.1 + 9.3** | IE3 minimum, but motors **above 75 kW must be IE4**. Section 9 takes precedence. | **P-01 (90 kW) must be IE4.** P-02 (37 kW) can be IE3. An IE3 motor for P-01 would not comply. |
| **4.3 + Annex B** | Motors in Zone 1 areas need ATEX Ex d | **P-01 is in the wet well, which is Zone 1, so it needs Ex d.** P-02 is in the valve chamber, which is non-hazardous. |
| 4.4 | Power cables at least 2.5 mm² | Check the cable spec. |
| 4.5 | Panel and motor terminal enclosures IP65 or better | Check the panels and terminal boxes. |
| **7.4** | Delivery within 16 weeks of the purchase order. **Offers over 16 weeks will be rejected.** | This one alone can get the offer rejected, so confirm our lead time. |
| 9.2 | Ambient design temperature 50 °C | Motors are usually rated for 40 °C, so check derating, especially for P-01 at 90 kW. |

## Other points

- **I couldn't see the offer itself.** The repo only has `tender.md` and `agent_analysis.md`, so I couldn't confirm any of the "our offer" values (5 years, RAL 5015, 400 V 50 Hz). Those need checking against the actual offer.
- **The tender copy may be incomplete.** Clause numbers skip from 7.1 to 7.4, so 7.2 and 7.3 are missing. If there's a fuller version of the document, check it for more commercial terms.
- The analysis isn't reliable enough to sign off on. I'd treat it as unchecked and rebuild it from the tender.

I can rewrite `agent_analysis.md` with every clause and a column for our offer's value. If you add the offer document, I can fill that column in and give a comply or doesn't-comply verdict for each line.
